[1/2] Plan: add an optional headless visual audit and screenshot harness for the cockpit

impact_assessment.why: The inventory guard proves controls and tests but cannot see contrast, target size, overflow or console regressions in the rendered cockpit, and screenshots alone are not measurable evidence
impact_assessment.benefits: Repeatable viewport screenshots plus measured layout, contrast, tap-target, label, overlap and console findings without touching the runtime or installing a Python dependency
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: optional Edge/Chrome executable only, no Python package; concurrency: one in-process server and per-viewport browser profile, no shared state; state: writes only to a temp workdir and the user-supplied output directory, never to the cockpit surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: stdlib-only wrapper and parser tests, exact iframe viewports, decorative/overflow filters, opt-in --check, Why/Fix exit paths, ADR-042 and documentation; no static or server changes

[1/2] Plan: make VoidFarer Windows-only and replace the neon multi-device cockpit with a readable desktop command console

impact_assessment.why: The user directed Windows-only operation and rejected the previous UI; G-011 still demanded tablet/phone/touch/safe-area behavior, package metadata claimed OS independence, and the cockpit used 8-11px text, mobile breakpoints and a layout that overflowed below 1920x1080
impact_assessment.benefits: One explicit Windows target, no dead mobile/touch code, readable 12px+ labels, a two-column terminal/radar layout with a full-width command dock, and measured zero findings at five Windows viewports
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ui_required evidence is stale until a new reviewed UI task finishes; dependency: only an optional local Edge/Chrome for the audit; concurrency: the dirty tree blocks ui begin until the user commits; state: static UI, tests, docs and pyproject change, while the simulation is untouched
impact_assessment.mitigation: 496-test suite, 4/4 project gates, five-viewport plus menu audit with zero findings, Windows-only tests that forbid touch/mobile markers, ADR-043, and screenshots copied to the ignored ui-review folder for human review
